summary: Iteration 4: Backend + frontend testing for Emergent managed push (POST /api/register-push) and ElevenLabs TTS (POST /api/reports/{id}/tts), plus regression. Backend: 23/23 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py covering (a) /register-push auth + own_user 201 + other_user 403 + admin-for-other 201 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY tolerated (upstream 401 → 201 with note), (b) TTS 401 no-token / 404 bad-id / 403 foreign-report by non-management / 200 happy-path returns audio_data_url starting with 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,' and bytes > 1000 (ONE call to save credits), (c) send_push fire-and-forget verified: report create → 200 with populated ai_summary, digest weekly → 200 with text + report_ids, signature PATCH → 200 ok:true — all succeed despite placeholder push key. Regression smoke (auth/me, list reports, report detail with signature persisted, weather, digest schedule GET, customers list, portal-link create, transcribe empty→400) all green. Frontend E2E on 390x844 web preview: admin login → Home → tapped 'TEST Iteration4 Foreign Project' report → detail rendered → tapped tts-play-button: label transitioned 'Read aloud' → 'Generating…' → 'Resume' at ~24s (Resume instead of Pause is expected on web due to autoplay-block; audioUrl was set, player just didn't auto-start on web). No error alert, no red-screen, only benign warnings ('expo-notifications listener not supported on web' — module-level import side effect; 'shadow*' style deprecation).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning at runtime: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — several StyleSheet entries use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Consider migrating to `boxShadow` for web parity or wrapping in Platform.select. Non-blocking. Reference: multiple screens (search grep -rn shadowColor /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/src).

action_items: None blocking. All iteration-4 backend + frontend acceptance criteria met.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` (or Platform.select) to silence the React Native Web deprecation warning.

(Optional) In app/_layout.tsx, the `expo-notifications` module import triggers a web-only warning about push-token listeners even though the code is guarded by Platform.OS. If you want a fully clean console on web, dynamic-import expo-notifications only on native (require() inside a `Platform.OS !== 'web'` block).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1560 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, reports, customers, digest, push, tts, files, transcribe, visits, weather). Growing monolith will hurt review/test velocity.

send_push is invoked from inline try/except in the request path (e.g., signature endpoint). Non-blocking is correct, but it still awaits the HTTP call before returning (up to 10s timeout on placeholder key). For preview/prod resilience, consider `asyncio.create_task(send_push(...))` so the response returns immediately regardless of upstream latency.

/api/reports/{id}/tts synthesizes on every call and returns a full base64 payload — no caching. For a 2-minute summary at 128kbps that's ~2 MB per call. Consider persisting audio_data_url or an object-storage path on the Report doc keyed by (report_id, ai_summary hash) to avoid re-burning ElevenLabs credits when the same summary is re-read.

TTS role check uses `doc['user_id'] != user['id']` for non-management. Role `Sales`/`Labor`/`Production` are all treated the same. Confirm this is intended (e.g., Sales cannot TTS someone else's report). Documented in code path lines 1183-1185.

register_push upserts into `push_tokens` by (user_id, device_token). If a user swaps device_token but reuses user_id the old token stays forever. Consider a TTL index or an explicit /api/unregister-push.
